Retries#

Courier retries idempotent requests that fail with a connection error or a 5xx status. Pass retries: to change the number of attempts.

client = Courier.new(retries: 3)
client.get("/status")

Note

Requests with a body are only retried when retry_non_idempotent: true is set.

Backoff

The delay between attempts grows exponentially: base × 2attempt, capped at 30 seconds.

# Never wait more than 10 seconds
client = Courier.new(max_delay: 10)
OptionDefaultDescription
retries2Attempts after the first one
base_delay0.5Seconds before the first retry
